title: Not Sturdy At All
text: Not Sturdy At All. These tomato cages aren’t very good. They are much smaller than a typical metal cage. They are difficult to keep at the full height. There is no locking mechanism for the telescoping legs. They’re also difficult to get evenly spaced.
